name: rsi2_colour_timing
written: 2026-11-20, before any script was written or any outcome computed
operator: 11/20, with 7 chart screenshots (11/19-11/20, 1-minute, RSI-2 panel with 90/10 bands): 'The red exhaustion bars tell you there is an exhaustion rise in profit coming, mostly followed by an exhaustion stall. A green exhaustion bar tells you that they're oversold and a profit run is coming after the green is done ... The run of profit starts at the beginning of the red exhaustion indicator and after the green exhaustion indicator ends.' My restatement of the two timings was confirmed: 'Yes, pre-register it'.
question: On 1-minute bars, does buying at (1) the start of a red segment (RSI-2 first at or above 90) or (2) the end of a green segment (RSI-2 first back above 10) catch a run that beats the same minute on other names and pays the real spread?

Neither timing below (red START as an entry, green END as an entry) was graded.

name filter (at the signal bar, live val: price $20-$400; day change vs prior close >= +1.5% (the desk's admission floor); signal bar 09:45-15:30 ET
indicator: RSI-2, Wilder (alpha 1/2, adjust=False) on SIP 1-minute closes of the session, seeded at the first change from 09:30; >= 10 bars after the seed before any signal (weight of the seed < 0.1%). avg loss 0 -> 100; avg gain = avg loss = 0 -> no reading. A NaN close restarts the seed.
refractory: one entry per (rule, name) per 15 minutes; a signal while that rule's trade on the name is open is skipped (counted)
timing note (live vs chart): the chart colours the line segment leading INTO the bar that reaches 90, so on a finished chart red appears to start at the low. Live, red is known only when bar t closes at >= 90; the rule uses that moment.
cost: net = gross - the real SIP quoted spread in the 60 s before entry (news_source.fetch_quotes, shared cache); spread > 15 bp not traded
gross-first (TEST_STANDARD): before any quote: a rule whose gross upper bound (mean + 2 x day-clustered SE over all its candidates) is below +2.0 bp is FAIL-gross and no quotes are fetched for it
sample: per rule, candidates drawn in order of the lowest sha256('rsi2col'|rule|day|sym|t); quote, keep if spread <= 15 bp; stop at 1,500 traded per half

controls (TEST_STANDARD, all on GROSS wi.PRIMARY same-minute: the same entry minute on up to 5 other universe names passing the same filter at that minute, same exit rule evaluated on THEIR RSI-2 series (if their exit condition never fires, the 15-bar cap)
controls (TEST_STANDARD, all on GROSS wi.same-name later: a random minute strictly after t+15 on the same name-day (up to 60 min later), same exit rule
controls (TEST_STANDARD, all on GROSS wi.fixed-hold: the same entry held a fixed 5 and 15 minutes (information: shows whether the colour exit adds anything over a plain hold)
controls (TEST_STANDARD, all on GROSS wi.unconditional: a random minute on a random filtered name-day, same exit rule

statistic: per rule and half: mean gross, mean net, lift over the primary control (gross), day-clustered t; MDE = 2.8 x SE printed before any mean

pass (per rule, all required).edge: lift over the PRIMARY control > 0 in both halves, pooled day-clustered t >= 2.5
pass (per rule, all required).profitable: mean net (after the real spread) >= +2.0 bp in both halves
pass (per rule, all required).robust: top-1% winsorized mean net > 0 in both halves
pass (per rule, all required).size: >= 300 traded per half; MDE > 10 bp in either half = UNDERPOWERED -> UNPROVEN (not FAIL)

fail: anything short of pass. No retuning of 90/10, the exits, the 15-bar cap, the filter or the window; a change is a new prereg on data that has now been seen.
information_only: the desk bracket (+20/-50, 15 min) as the exit for both rules
the panel's SMA conditions (close vs 1-minute SMA200 with prior-session warm-up, and vs SMA5) added to each rule
RED_START restricted to bars where RSI2[t-1] < 50 (a fast rise into red)
CONFIRM period 9/24-11/18 (already read by other studies)
win %, median hold, share of total from the top 1% of trades, by time of day

unit tests: RSI-2 matches a hand computation; RED_START fires only on the cross bar; GREEN_END fires on the first bar back above 10; exits sell the next open; the 15-bar cap sells the close of t+15
null canary: a random walk with no edge must not read EDGE; a planted +15 bp run after red start must read EDGE
counts printed: signals, refractory skips, gated by spread, missing quotes, FAIL-gross
if_pass: result-skeptic review; then the same 20-session forward holdout on recorded IEX quotes as opening_grid, and a check that live ai_entry_watch.live_cm_rsi fires on the same bars on one replayed day, before any default-off arm
if_fail: record it; RSI-2 colour timing on 1-minute bars joins the green-start and red-exit results as closed
pre_run_review: result-skeptic reviews this prereg before any code runs (standing checkpoint)
fetch rule: quotes only after 16:05 ET (data key shared with the live dashboard), behind any study already in the fetch queue
script: tools/studies/rsi2_colour_timing.py (to be written after the review)

rules (three hypotheses).RED_START: completed bar t with RSI2[t] >= 90 and RSI2[t-1] < 90. Buy the OPEN of t+1. Exit at the OPEN after the first completed bar s > t with RSI2[s] < 90 (the stall); if none by t+15, sell the CLOSE of t+15.
rules (three hypotheses).GREEN_END: completed bar t with RSI2[t] > 10 and RSI2[t-1] <= 10. Buy the OPEN of t+1. Exit at the OPEN after the first completed bar s > t that ends a red segment (RSI2[s] < 90 after some bar in (t, s) >= 90); if none by t+15, sell the CLOSE of t+15.
rules (three hypotheses).RED_STOP: operator 11/20 'Yes, add the red stop rule' (the real-time version of 'the run starts at the beginning of red'). At the open of bar t, with RSI2[t-1] < 90 and Wilder state (avg gain G, avg loss L, close C) from completed bar t-1, the trigger price is P = C + 9L - G (the close at which RSI2[t] would equal 90; if 9L - G <= 0, P = C). A buy-stop rests at P for bar t only. FILL if high[t] >= P, at max(P, open[t]) (a gap through fills at the open). Exit: the OPEN after the first completed bar s >= t with RSI2[s] < 90 (a pop that fails within bar t sells at the open of t+1); else the CLOSE of t+15. Same filter, window, refractory, spread gate and cost (spread in the 60 s before bar t starts) as the other rules; extra stop slippage of +2 bp printed as a sensitivity.

controls for RED_STOP: SUPERSEDED by amended_1 'RED_STOP (skeptic addendum)' B3 and M8 (same-distance buy-stop controls; same-name window exit+2..exit+62 measured from close[t'-1]).
multiplicity: three rules (RED_START, GREEN_END, RED_STOP); the EDGE bar t >= 2.5 stays above Bonferroni-3 (2.39)

amended_cross_price.GREEN_CROSS (new, scored, 4th rule): at the open of bar t, if completed bar t-1 was GREEN (Pine rule), compute the two prices at which green ends UPWARD on bar t: P10 = close[t-1] + max(L/9 - G, 0) rounded up to the cent (RSI2 back to 10, Pine rma state G/L from t-1) and S5 = mean of closes t-4..t-1 rounded up (close reaches the 5-bar average including itself).
